### Threshold cascade
An interactive model of Granovetter-style threshold dynamics: each node acts once a
sufficient share of its neighbours has. Adjust the average threshold and the network
density to see why some cascades run away and others stall after two steps.

Exponential random graph models of interstate alliance ties, testing whether alliances
follow from dyadic attributes or from endogenous network processes such as triadic
closure.
